moments.text: Infrared view, picture tilted, over streaky grey layers; crosshair at centre, black redaction boxes along the bottom.
The view zooms in and turns grainy; a small dark smudge sits just above-left of the crosshair.
Two small bright spots, one following the other, enter at the left edge below the crosshair and move right.
The view zooms back out; the two spots, now tiny, are right of the crosshair and leave the right edge.
A tracking box appears above the crosshair around the dark smudge and slowly slides down to the crosshair centre.
The picture flashes white, then settles darker and wider; corner brackets now frame the tracking box until the end.
